facts.excerpt: TenTrade reserves the sole and absolute discretion to determine whether trading activity violates the program’s risk framework, spirit, or operational objectives. Where prohibited or abusive conduct is identified or reasonably suspected, TenTrade may take any action it deems appropriate, including trade cancellation, payout denial, account termination, or permanent disqualification from the program.
